block.bearing.copycat_panel.tooltip.beha: Takes on the look of the _block in your hand_ when it can. Use it _once more_ to switch the _facing_ or _powered_ variant. A _Wrench_ strips the material off again.
block.bearing.copycat_panel.tooltip.summ: A thin _panel_ that can wear the texture of any _full block_. _Bars_ and _Trapdoors_ work as well.
block.bearing.copycat_step.tooltip.behav: Takes on the look of the _block in your hand_ when it can. Use it _once more_ to switch the _facing_ or _powered_ variant. A _Wrench_ strips the material off again.
block.bearing.copycat_step.tooltip.summa: A small _step_ that can wear the texture of any _full block_.
block.bearing.metal_bracket.tooltip.summ: A heavy-duty _metal_ clamp that dresses up _Shafts, Cogwheels_ and _Pipes_ with a factory feel.
block.bearing.placard.tooltip.behaviour1: _Puts_ the _item_ you hold on display. If the same item is _already shown_, gives off a short _Redstone_ pulse instead.
block.bearing.placard.tooltip.summary: A _brass_ wall plaque for _showing off_ a single _item_. Keeps working on moving contraptions.
block.bearing.wooden_bracket.tooltip.sum: A rustic _wooden_ clamp that dresses up _Shafts, Cogwheels_ and _Pipes_ with a homely touch.
